title: Equil pump - pump unreacheable, problem with reservoir and battery status
body:
Aaps keeps notificating that pump is unreacheable while it's not true. Application keeps adjusting insulin delivery and loop is working. Also aaps doesnt refresh battery level and insulin reservoir level in equil pump. It can keep the same values for few days. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/149b56b2-0a3d-4cd5-968e-efdbda672da1)

[AndroidAPS._2026-04-04_10-24-53_.22.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26480858/AndroidAPS._2026-04-04_10-24-53_.22.zip)

Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://wiki.aaps.app/en/latest/GettingHelp/AccessingLogFiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new

comments.body:
The issue seems to be phone specific ie. too agressive BT optimization.
try another phone
